entities.name: Sevilay Öztürk
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sevilay Öztürk is a Turkish Paralympic swimmer. She competes in the disability category of S5 in freestyle, backstroke and butterfly, specializing in sprint events. She competed in the 2016 Summer Paralympics.
